en: A two-panel color postcard. The upper image shows a modern brick railway-station building with flower pots, benches, a tall black metal clock tower, and mid‑rise apartment blocks in the background. The entrance has shopfront windows and signage above the door. The lower image shows the adjacent rail yard of the same station with multiple tracks, platforms connected by covered pedestrian bridges, freight wagons, and surrounding residential buildings. In the center between the two images the caption reads "Borlänge station".
